comment_text: Love Jalen Brown but no Camara in the trade.  I’d give scoot first.
I would be shocked if the Blazers got something good. It literally has never happened. Stars do not end up here in trades.
I wouldn’t trade TC for JB. He’s the core of the team. Think he can grow a lot. I feel that players like him, DC and Deni make winning teams.
Trade for JB please. Anyone except Deni plus the bucks pics. Make it happen.

- Sure, I'd love JB on this team. But come on, the odds are minimal, and I think a lot of people and analysts or overvaluing the picks Milwaukee gets back from us. I've heard of them saying it's those picks, JG for salary (makes sense), Yang and Scoot, but I don't really like that idea with money and age at that point for the team long term. It's a high risk, high short term reward move.
- As for Touf, as I always say, he's my guy, probably his biggest fan and appreciator. He definitely played low grade defense to start the season, making a ton of mistakes and also playing actually bad defense overall, which completely confused. He figured it out though and nailed it. I hope he'll get a lot better next season. At the end of the season, he showed confidence on offense, actually playing aggressively on that end, and absolutely killing it to boot, proving he CAN ABSOLUTELY be a reliable, solid quality scorer. He's still untouchable to me.
- Him and Deni are untouchables. The only two on the roster. Donovan is close to being one of them, but he needs to continue to get better, smarter and more versatile and aggressive on the offensive end.
My eyes tell me that Tou is an elite defender.  Probably a little better than you think he was last year.  He also is a good shooter from 3 and unlike everyone else…he was available…priceless!
This will never happen.  He just signed a Supermax Contract with Boston.
